contract.instructions:
Development preview, not IRD-approved, not tax advice and not filing-ready. Read lktax://supported-scenarios and lktax://known-issues before offering help.

Before collecting tax facts, show lk_get_disclaimer verbatim and obtain explicit agreement to its current version. Start a fresh lk_session only after explaining that it discards existing facts and consent; never reset an existing session silently. Then use lk_accept_disclaimer only after the user agrees.

Never collect names, NIC, TIN, employer names, bank or account details, raw documents or credentials. The server has no document ingestion or export tools. Amounts and tool results reach the host and possibly its provider.

Ask only for missing facts reported by lk_next_questions, confirm every requested zero and boolean, and use lk_set_facts only for user-confirmed facts. Follow the dependency-aware interview: skip only booleans explicitly marked not_applicable_facts, never infer an absent amount as zero, and stop gathering facts for blocked or out_of_scope status. Show blocking_guidance and obtain professional review; only change a fact after a genuine user-confirmed correction. Readiness states describe intake, not provisional tax amounts or filing readiness. Use lk_check_scope and stop for out-of-scope cases. Partial status requires reading the reasons; it does not guarantee computation support.

Annual calculations support only the published annual rules year. Instalment planning has its own year and requires separate current-year scope, confirmed method eligibility, an independently prepared gross-tax basis and reconciled credits. Never copy annual facts or results into another year automatically.

Let deterministic tools perform every tax calculation. Present display_summary verbatim with all warnings and interpretation alternatives. Never add, multiply, round or invent a tax amount, choose an interpretation for the user, or bypass isError by estimating it yourself. Ask for genuinely missing facts or refer unresolved cases for professional review.

Use lk_review_return after a supported estimate to inspect cited cage references and manual review gaps. Leave null cage amounts unset; never turn reference amounts into refund claims, carry-forward entitlements, gross remittances or credit splits. Review is not an export or checklist approval. Filing-obligation decisions, filing outputs, payments and submission are unavailable. Zero payable is not a no-return-required decision. Never access RAMIS or ask for its credentials. Use lk_session wipe only on the user request; it discards facts and consent.

tools.name: lk_accept_disclaimer
tools.description: Record explicit user agreement to the exact current disclaimer in memory. Never infer consent. Required before fact entry and calculation.

tools.name: lk_check_scope
tools.description: Evaluate confirmed triage scope answers deterministically. Final foreign-credit and interpretation flags are derived from actual amounts by computation. Out-of-scope cases must stop. Partial status is not a promise that computation is implemented.

tools.name: lk_compute_return
tools.description: Compute a development estimate for local employment, local business net profit, interest, investment rent and supported local reliefs/donations; final-WHT resident-company dividends are informational only. Also supports confirmed qualifying foreign salary and net foreign services with single-source, single-country capped foreign credits. Uses an assumed local-first deduction allocation and capped progressive stacking. Show every interpretation warning and alternative summary; never select a preferred interpretation or claim the allocation is optimal. Rechecks consent, facts and scope every time. Not a full return. Show display_summary verbatim. Never recompute or bypass an error. Exports are unavailable.

tools.name: lk_explain
tools.description: Explain a computed line using deterministic inputs, formula, rule version and source. Recomputes from current facts to avoid stale results. Never invent arithmetic.

tools.name: lk_get_disclaimer
tools.description: Show this versioned disclaimer verbatim before asking for any tax facts. English development preview only. Then ask the user to agree.

tools.name: lk_next_questions
tools.description: Get dependency-aware interview progress and only the next missing writable facts. All monetary amounts, including zeros, require confirmation. Foreign eligibility booleans are requested only when confirmed amounts make them relevant. Placeholder readiness means selector amounts are unanswered; it is not a provisional tax estimate. Stop collecting facts for blocked or out_of_scope status and show blocking_guidance. Intake completeness does not establish filing readiness. Never ask for names, TIN, NIC or credentials.

tools.name: lk_plan_instalments
tools.description: Plan one YA 2026/27 quarterly instalment under the 12 August 2026 re-revised IRD circular. Requires active session and current explicit consent. Confirm current-year scope separately in this input. A must be gross tax prepared externally under the selected method, not an annual net balance or a copied current-year estimate. Method 1 uses YA 2025/26 gross tax; 2(i) uses zero; 2(ii)/(iii) use adjusted previous-year figures, with final SET allowed only for quarter one before return finalisation and exactly one return revision thereafter; 2(iv) uses an independently prepared current-year estimate in the first year only. Never infer eligibility. C includes actual earlier instalments and eligible full-year APIT/AIT/WHT, split into deducted and expected remaining, without overlap or final WHT. No foreign-credit basis, Method 3, corporate cases, payments or identifiers. Confirm timely notice when switching from Method 1 to 2(iii). Display display_summary and administrative requirements verbatim. Zero payable is not a filing exemption. Recompute each quarter with actual paid credits; schedule dates do not assume future payments.

tools.name: lk_review_return
tools.description: Review the current supported annual estimate against verified YA 2025/26 return and schedule cage references. Recomputes current facts and enforces the same consent, scope, eligibility and financial validations as lk_compute_return. Returns mapped preview amounts, arithmetic checks, trace coverage, manual review gaps and a conservative return-format hint. Null cage amounts must remain unset. Reference amounts are not filing values: potential overpayment is not an approved refund, and unused solar amounts require historical reconciliation. Never invent primary/secondary APIT, Table 08, withholding or payment-row splits, exempt disclosures or gross remittances from aggregate facts. Final dividend WHT already deducted is informational at Schedule 6A, never additional unpaid tax or an advance credit. Preserve every flag and interpretation alternative; do not select one. Show display_summary verbatim. This is not a complete return, export, filing obligation or pre-export checklist approval. No files, identifiers, payments or RAMIS access.

tools.name: lk_session
tools.description: Start a fresh memory-only YA 2025/26 session or wipe it. Starting discards all prior facts and consent. No identifiers, files or credentials. No data persists after shutdown.

tools.name: lk_set_facts
tools.description: Set only user-confirmed facts, with LKR amounts as decimal strings. Never send identifiers or arbitrary text. Confirm zero amounts; do not guess missing answers. business_net is local net profit computed outside this tool. Collect deductions separately. Every amount must be user-confirmed and eligible. Do not enter final dividend WHT as ait_wht_credit. Collect foreign aggregates and eligibility in the foreign object, never in local income. Foreign amounts must already be converted to LKR. Foreign tax paid must be eligible income tax on that same income from one confirmed source in one country; do not include Sri Lankan APIT or pool sources. other_income_or_claims is true for non-qualifying or otherwise unsupported foreign income, unsupported dividends, loan-funded solar claims, rent expense deductions or any other unsupported income or claim. Scope answers are required unless an already confirmed exclusion stops intake. Confirm explicit false answers when requested. Use lk_next_questions to determine relevant foreign eligibility booleans; never invent answers for inapplicable facts. Scope foreign hints cannot override flags derived from computation amounts.

rent.description: Gross local investment rent, with no repair or other expense deduction claimed.

final_wht_dividends_gross.description: Resident-company dividends with final withholding already deducted; otherwise mark other_income_or_claims true.

final_wht_dividends_deducted.description: Actual final WHT deducted on these dividends. Informational only, never an advance tax credit.

apit_credit.description: Sri Lankan APIT actually paid, including Table 08; exclude foreign income tax.

ait_wht_credit.description: Sri Lankan non-final advance credits only; exclude foreign income tax and final dividend WHT.

solar_available.description: Confirmed eligible expenditure remaining after all prior relief claims for panels on own premises connected to the national grid. Loan-funded claims are not supported.

approved_charity_cash.description: Cash donations to approved charitable institutions only; exclude in-kind donations.

government_donations.description: Eligible current-year donations to Government or qualifying specified institutions, including in-kind donations.

government_donations_brought_forward.description: Only an eligible and independently verified Government-donation carry-forward under Annexure 3(f); legacy qualifying-payment balances are unsupported.

samurdhi_shop_contributions.description: Confirmed eligible contributions to a shop for a female Samurdhi beneficiary, recommended and confirmed by the department.

employment_lkr.description: Annual foreign-employer salary already converted to LKR; do not include it again in local employment.

service_net_lkr.description: Annual net foreign service business income already computed and converted to LKR; exclude it from local business_net.

foreign_tax_paid.description: Eligible foreign income tax actually paid on this same qualifying income in ONE country. Exclude foreign VAT and Sri Lankan APIT.

credit_eligibility_confirmed.description: Eligible income tax on the same YA income, paid within the statutory time limit or a permitted extension, with evidence.

single_source_confirmed.description: The claimed foreign tax and ALL foreign income in this credit calculation belong to one source and one country; no pooling across jobs/businesses.

resources.name: annual-sources
resources.description: Annual rule citations and evidence status, including explicitly assumed interpretation policies.

resources.name: cage-map
resources.description: Verified source references for supported annual cage mappings. Practitioner-unreviewed; unsupported or insufficiently evidenced filing fields remain unresolved.

resources.name: document-checklist
resources.description: Manual evidence checklist. Do not upload documents or identifiers; ingestion and filing remain unavailable.

resources.name: fact-dictionary
resources.description: Writable fact dictionary and dependency-aware intake policy. Derived readiness is not a monetary estimate or filing decision.

resources.name: instalment-rules
resources.description: YA 2026/27 instalment source, verified dates and unreviewed rule version. Does not supply annual return rates.

resources.name: known-issues
resources.description: Dated unresolved rules, unavailable features and release blockers.

resources.name: rules
resources.description: Cited, unreviewed YA 2025/26 rules for the implemented local and qualifying foreign-income preview.

resources.name: supported-scenarios
resources.description: Current supported scenarios and explicit exclusions. Partial scope status does not imply calculation support.

prompts.name: do_i_need_to_file
prompts.title: Understand filing guidance limits
prompts.description: Explain that a deterministic filing-obligation decision is not implemented and refer for confirmation.
